exact: mating-type pheromone secretion involved in conjugation with cellular fusion
related: peptide pheromone export involved in positive regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion

definition: The regulated release of a mating pheromone, a peptide hormone that induces a behavioral or physiological response(s) from a responding organism or cell, that positively regulates a conjugation process that results in the union of cellular and genetic information from compatible mating types.
label: mating pheromone secretion involved in positive regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion
